summary: Virtualize long conversations and load older native timeline pages while preserving the reading anchor and server-rendered history and pending-send boundaries.

replay.detail: No persisted projections or replay changes.

compatibility.detail: Uses the existing native timeline paging cursor; adds no wire operation. Kit Transcript callers now explicitly supply their history knowledge; all repository callers are migrated. Mounted-row runtime windowing is opt-in for long transcripts.

downtime.detail: No service restart or coordinated rollout required.

recovery.detail: Failed history pages retain loaded messages and expose explicit retry; no persisted state changes.
